additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
The customer has raised a ticket regarding a black screen issue with no LED. They have checked the 24-volt supply, and it's okay. It seems the screen may be defective.
Please conduct an onsite visit to check the 24-volt power supply, verify the wiring, and check the backlighting etc. Also, please carry a spare HMI. If the HMI is found to be defective, proceed with the replacement.
